cases.id: server:CoinLedger is enabled
server:default config.yml is written on first enable
server:plugin.yml declares the ledger command and permissions
server:the fee account is created on enable

server:deposit and withdraw report the new balance
server:invalid amounts are rejected
server:withdrawals cannot overdraw an account
server:transfers move money and pay the fee
server:fees are rounded down to the cent
server:transfers need funds for the amount plus the fee
server:transfers are validated from left to right
server:frozen accounts can neither send nor receive
server:freeze and unfreeze report the state change
server:the maximum balance caps deposits and transfers
server:accounts.yml holds balances in cents
server:audit.log records each change as one line
server:rejected commands change nothing
server:history pages entries newest first
server:history rejects pages that do not exist
server:top ranks accounts by balance then name
